text: {"summary": "The prod cluster scores 52 on NSA and 55 on MITRE in kubescape. The main risks are over-privileged RBAC: a cluster-admin binding for the developers group and a wildcard ClusterRole bound to the ci-bot service account. Trivy PSS passed 17 of 17 controls, and trivy reports no critical or high vulnerabilities (4 MEDIUM vulnerabilities only). Node and control-plane checks were not run.", "targets": ["prod"], "frameworks": [{"name": "NSA", "passed": 10, "failed": 11, "skipped": 5, "score": 52}, {"name": "MITRE", "passed": 9, "failed": 9, "skipped": 5, "score": 55}], "findings": [{"severity": "HIGH", "title": "Developers group bound to cluster-admin", "resource": "ClusterRoleBinding/dev-team-admin", "controls": ["C-0035"], "evidence": "The digest shows dev-team-admin binding role cluster-admin to Group:/developers, and kubescape flags it under C-0035 Administrative Roles.", "fix": "kubectl delete clusterrolebinding dev-team-admin  # then bind the group to a namespaced 'edit' RoleBinding: kubectl create rolebinding dev-edit --clusterrole=edit --group=developers -n <ns>"}, {"severity": "HIGH", "title": "Wildcard ClusterRole ci-wildcard bound to ci-bot service account (secrets read, exec)", "resource": "ClusterRole/ci-wildcard; ClusterRoleBinding/ci-bot-wild; ServiceAccount ci/ci-bot", "controls": ["C-0035", "C-0015", "C-0002", "KSV-0041"], "evidence": "ci-wildcard is flagged by kubescape C-0035, C-0015 and C-0002 and by trivy KSV-0041 (Manage secrets), and ci-bot-wild binds it to ServiceAccount:ci/ci-bot.", "fix": "Replace the wildcard rules with the specific verbs, resources and namespaces CI needs, e.g. rules: [{apiGroups: [apps], resources: [deployments], verbs: [get, patch]}]. Convert the binding to a namespaced RoleBinding."}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Built-in admin/edit ClusterRoles flagged for secret management", "resource": "ClusterRole/admin; ClusterRole/edit", "controls": ["KSV-0041"], "evidence": "Trivy KSV-0041 (HIGH) lists ClusterRole/admin and ClusterRole/edit among 3 resources. Limit who is bound to admin/edit, and verify with: kubectl get clusterrole admin edit -o yaml"}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "Platform-default cluster-admin bindings", "resource": "ClusterRoleBinding/cluster-admin (Group:/system:masters); ClusterRoleBinding/helm-kube-system-traefik (kube-system/helm-traefik)", "controls": ["C-0035"], "evidence": "The digest lists cluster-admin for system:masters and for kube-system/helm-traefik.
